items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Harrison Brett played with him too.

ctx.x: I don't know him, but I know him.

Yeah. Howard Davis was with him. And then sometimes he used to use Harrison Brett. Harrison Brett played with him too. And he had, well, you see when Celestan came back after he had been sick so long, he had to restart all over again. You know he had high up with different groups, you understand? I mean he had to start from scratch in better words, you understand? He had Miss Kimball playing with him, you understand? And he had Manny Gabriel, he used to play with him, and he used to use Manny Gabriel's brother…
Manny Gabriel's brother, what was Manny Gabriel playing then? Saxophone?
